svg.text: The agentic core: a LangGraph state machine over ReflectivityState driving the refinement loop, plus the shared services every node calls. (Web UI / MCP UI omitted.)
Violet nodes make LLM calls · slate nodes are deterministic (no LLM). The LLM proposes & explains; code enforces invariants.
CLI (aure.cli): analyze · batch · resume · evaluate · import-refl1d · prepare · plot-results
MCP (mcp_server.py, FastMCP stdio/SSE) exposes the same workflow to AI assistants
Setup YAML (setup.py) — states-only schema · load_setup / load_manifest
• data file(s) — Q, R, dR • sample_description (free text)
• hypothesis (-h, optional) • config / constraints (states, shared params)

State accumulates via dict-deltas only (no in-place mutation); messages uses an append reducer. Routing in nodes/routing.py is pure (edge selection, no side effects). include_fitting=False truncates after modeling (prepare mode).
— called by the nodes above (dashed); none hold refl1d/bumps objects in persisted state
are rebuilt from JSON, never stored
The agent is the loop, not a single prompt: evaluation feeds the
results of the last fit back into the next modeling decision.
The LLM proposes & explains (parse, hypotheses, judge, refine);
code enforces invariants (χ²/BIC reverts, list-membership guard,
Models are JSON (ModelDefinition), rebuilt into refl1d objects on demand — never round-tripped as scripts.
